description: This Java class defines an Android Activity named LaunchActivity. It inflates a layout, initializes a button, and sets an onClick listener to start the NextActivity with a payload, then finishes itself.

classes.name: LaunchActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that launches NextActivity with a payload when a button is clicked.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that sets up the layout and button click listener to launch NextActivity.
